note: Per-brand market analysis and lifecycle-stage assessment for the flagship roster (authored 2026-07). Grounds strategy/brand_lifecycle.py and the home dashboard. Lifecycle stage uses the same keys as strategy/lifecycle.py (launch/growth/mature/loe). 'stage_confidence' is the analyst's confidence in the call; 'momentum' is the near-term revenue trajectory (accelerating/steady/declining). Evidence points, sales figures and competitor sets are an editorial synthesis of public information (company reports, FDA actions, trade press) through ~mid-2026 and are intended as a sound, decision-useful starting point -- not an audited financial source. Validate figures with each brand team before external use. Where a specific 2025 sales figure is cited it reflects reported full-year or run-rate figures found in public disclosures.

evidence: Darolutamide franchise at blockbuster run-rate and among Bayer's fastest-growing assets.
Label expanded from nmCRPC into mHSPC (with docetaxel, ARASENS) and chemo-free mHSPC (ARANOTE), widening the addressable pool.
Differentiated on CNS-penetration/tolerability versus other ARIs, supporting share gains.
Nubeqa.whitespace: Undertreated mHSPC intensification; broaden beyond urology into oncology co-management.
Nubeqa.campaign_posture: Grow the market and defend differentiation: HCP education on intensification + tolerability RTBs; expand from urology KOLs to community oncology.

evidence: Finerenone uptake building in CKD associated with T2D (FIDELIO/FIGARO evidence base).
FINEARTS-HF read-out extends opportunity into HFmrEF/HFpEF, a large new population.
Non-steroidal MRA class carving space between RAAS blockade and SGLT2 inhibition.
Kerendia.whitespace: Guideline-directed layering (MRA + SGLT2i) is under-adopted; multi-specialty CKM messaging.
Kerendia.campaign_posture: Category-building launch-into-growth: reframe finerenone as complementary not competitive to SGLT2is; target the cardio-renal-metabolic overlap.

evidence: 2 mg Eylea faces active US biosimilar erosion (Amgen's Pavblu launched 2024; Sandoz/Celltrion/Biocon/Alvotech-Teva settlements cluster launches in H2 2026).
Defense strategy is conversion to Eylea HD (8 mg) for extended dosing intervals.
Anti-VEGF category also pressured by faricimab (Vabysmo) and longer-duration entrants.
Eylea.loe_horizon: in progress (2 mg); HD extends franchise life
Eylea.whitespace: Convert existing 2 mg patients to HD before biosimilar step-edits lock in; treatment-burden narrative.
Eylea.campaign_posture: LOE defense: accelerate HD conversion, arm HCPs with durability/real-world persistence data, protect high-volume retina accounts.

evidence: Post-peak DOAC facing generic rivaroxaban across major markets and IRA price negotiation exposure.
Broad label (NVAF, VTE, CAD/PAD, pediatric VTE) but growth ceded to apixaban in many markets.
Lifecycle now about managed decline and selective indication defense.
Xarelto.whitespace: Differentiated indications (CAD/PAD vascular dose, pediatrics) where genericization is slower.
Xarelto.campaign_posture: Harvest + defend: minimize promotional spend on commoditized NVAF, protect vascular/pediatric niches, emphasize adherence programs.

evidence: FDA-approved Oct 2025; US availability from Nov 2025 -- squarely in launch phase.
First-and-only dual NK1/NK3 receptor antagonist for moderate-to-severe VMS; hormone-free.
OASIS-1/2 pivotal data show significant VMS frequency reduction vs placebo at weeks 4 and 12.
key_catalysts: differentiation vs. fezolinetant (Veozah) on sleep/mood endpoints
Lynkuet.whitespace: Large under-treated non-hormonal VMS population; women avoiding/ineligible for HT.
Lynkuet.campaign_posture: Full launch build: disease-state + brand awareness, HCP mechanism education, patient activation and access support; own the hormone-free narrative.

evidence: Established RCC/HCC franchise; growth now driven by new indications and combinations.
CABINET data enabled expansion into neuroendocrine tumors (pNET/epNET).
IO-TKI combination (with nivolumab) anchors 1L RCC positioning.
Cabometyx.whitespace: NET is a fresh growth vector on a mature backbone; combination sequencing education.
Cabometyx.campaign_posture: Defend-and-extend: sustain oncology share with combination + new-indication messaging; NET as a distinct launch-within-a-brand.

evidence: Lanreotide facing generic/biosimilar depot competition; franchise in managed erosion.
GEP-NET and acromegaly base being defended while Ipsen rejuvenates the portfolio.
Somatostatin-analog category commoditizing on the depot formulation.
Somatuline.whitespace: Administration convenience and nurse-support programs as switching friction.
Somatuline.campaign_posture: LOE defense/harvest: lean on services + adherence, protect NET prescribers, avoid heavy new-patient acquisition spend.

evidence: Established botulinum-toxin franchise spanning therapeutic (cervical dystonia, spasticity) and aesthetic (glabellar lines) uses.
Competes in a crowded, brand-loyal toxin category with duration/onset differentiation.
Aesthetic segment cyclical/consumer-sensitive; therapeutic segment steadier.
Dysport.whitespace: Duration-of-effect and injector-relationship differentiation; therapeutic spasticity expansion.
Dysport.campaign_posture: Defend share via injector loyalty + differentiation; segment therapeutic (medical, evidence-led) from aesthetic (consumer, brand-led).

evidence: Elafibranor is a first-in-class PPAR (alpha/delta) agonist in PBC, early launch phase.
Second-line PBC (with UDCA or as monotherapy) addressing inadequate responders.
Competes with a near-simultaneous new PBC entrant, making launch execution decisive.
Iqirvo.whitespace: UDCA-inadequate responders needing 2L options; symptom (pruritus) burden.
Iqirvo.campaign_posture: Competitive launch: rapid share-of-voice in a two-horse 2L race; differentiate on response + tolerability, secure early prescriber trials.

evidence: Liposomal irinotecan growing on first-line metastatic PDAC expansion (NALIRIFOX regimen, NAPOLI-3).
Moves from post-gemcitabine 2L into 1L, enlarging the treated population.
Pancreatic cancer remains high-unmet-need with few regimen options.
Onivyde.whitespace: 1L regimen switching from FOLFIRINOX where tolerability/logistics favor NALIRIFOX.
Onivyde.campaign_posture: Growth via regimen conversion: arm oncologists with 1L efficacy + manageability data; support regimen-adoption logistics.

evidence: Epcoritamab (CD3xCD20 bispecific) in early commercial ramp across R/R DLBCL (3L+) and R/R FL (3L+).
Subcutaneous administration differentiates from IV bispecifics/CAR-T logistics.
AbbVie/Genmab partnership resourcing a broad development program moving to earlier lines.
Epkinly.whitespace: Off-the-shelf bispecific for community centers unable to deliver CAR-T; fixed-duration potential.
Epkinly.campaign_posture: Launch build with heavy HCP enablement: CRS management + step-up dosing education, site-of-care activation, KOL advocacy.

evidence: Tisotumab vedotin (ADC) converted to full approval on confirmatory data (innovaTV 301) in 2L+ recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer.
First ADC established in cervical cancer, a modest but underserved population.
Pfizer partnership supports commercialization reach.
Tivdak.whitespace: Clear 2L standard where prior options are limited; AE-management support lowers adoption friction.
Tivdak.campaign_posture: Growth launch: own the 2L cervical narrative, invest in ocular-AE prophylaxis education to de-risk prescribing.

evidence: Genmab-originated, J&J-commercialized anti-CD38 backbone of multiple-myeloma therapy; multi-billion royalty engine.
Subcutaneous (Faspro) conversion sustained franchise convenience advantage.
Expanded into newly-diagnosed (transplant-eligible and -ineligible) and AL amyloidosis.
key_catalysts: competition from other CD38s / bispecifics / CAR-T
Darzalex.whitespace: Frontline quad regimens and maintenance; defend against novel immunotherapy displacement.
Darzalex.campaign_posture: Defend the backbone: frontline combination + MRD-negativity messaging; SC convenience; but note commercial lead sits with J&J.

evidence: Genmab-originated, Novartis-commercialized anti-CD20; self-administered SC monthly injection still gaining RMS share.
At-home administration differentiates from infused anti-CD20 (ocrelizumab).
High-efficacy B-cell depletion moving earlier in the MS treatment algorithm.
key_catalysts: competition from ocrelizumab SC and ublituximab
Kesimpta.whitespace: Patients preferring at-home dosing; early-line high-efficacy switchers.
Kesimpta.campaign_posture: Growth: convenience + high-efficacy narrative, patient self-injection support; but recognize Novartis owns commercialization.

evidence: 2025 sales ~USD 4.8B (+58% YoY; +77% US), among the fastest-growing oncology brands.
NATALEE early-breast-cancer (adjuvant) expansion opened a large new HR+/HER2- population; leading NBRx share in EBC.
Consistent OS benefit across Phase III metastatic trials; NCCN Category 1 Preferred, high ESMO-MCBS ratings.
Kisqali.whitespace: Convert EBC NBRx leadership into share; head-to-head OS story vs. abemaciclib.
Kisqali.campaign_posture: Aggressive growth: dual metastatic (OS) + adjuvant (recurrence-reduction) narratives; oncology + community activation, adherence support for long adjuvant duration.

evidence: Inclisiran (twice-yearly siRNA) scaling through cardiology and primary-care via buy-and-bill/office administration.
Adherence advantage (2 doses/year) versus daily orals and injectable PCSK9 mAbs.
V-Innovate/ORION evidence base and guideline positioning building.
Leqvio.whitespace: Statin-inadequate/PCSK9-naive patients; adherence-failure populations; PCP channel.
Leqvio.campaign_posture: Growth: reframe LDL-C control around twice-yearly adherence; build office-administration operational playbooks; broaden from cardiology to primary care.

evidence: Pre-taxane mCRPC approval (PSMAfore, Mar 2025) roughly tripled eligible patients; a key pillar of >$5B peak-sales ambition.
Recent run-rate ~USD 564M with +46% growth; supply/manufacturing capacity expanding.
PSMAddition data extend radioligand therapy toward earlier disease.
Pluvicto.whitespace: Pre-taxane setting is the growth engine; nuclear-medicine capacity is the constraint, not demand.
Pluvicto.campaign_posture: Growth with operational focus: drive pre-taxane adoption while enabling nuclear-medicine referral pathways and site readiness.

evidence: Established IL-17A franchise across PsO, PsA, axSpA; defended via new indications (hidradenitis suppurativa) and formulations.
Large multi-indication base but facing IL-23 and biosimilar-era pressure over the horizon.
Lifecycle management via HS and IV formulation extends utility.
Cosentyx.whitespace: HS as a fresh indication; retention against IL-23 switching.
Cosentyx.campaign_posture: Defend-and-extend: new-indication (HS) launches inside a mature brand; loyalty + speed-of-response messaging vs. IL-23 class.

evidence: US AB-rated generics launched Jul 2025 (MSN/Novadoz Jul 22, Torrent Jul 24) after pediatric-exclusivity lapse.
Litigation ongoing around the '918 amorphous-form patent (expiry Nov 2026) but generic entry already underway.
Broad HF label (HFrEF, HFpEF/HFmrEF, pediatric) but revenue now eroding.
Entresto.whitespace: Limited; residual brand loyalty and pediatric/HFpEF niches.
Entresto.campaign_posture: LOE/harvest: pull back new-patient acquisition, defend adherent branded base and specialized indications, redirect spend to growth assets.

evidence: Oral factor-B inhibitor (complement pathway) in early launch across PNH, IgA nephropathy and C3 glomerulopathy.
Oral monotherapy differentiates from infused C5 inhibitors in PNH.
Multi-indication complement platform expanding label (IgAN, C3G).
key_catalysts: oral vs. infused C5 switching in PNH
Fabhalta.whitespace: Oral convenience in complement disease; rare-nephrology diagnosis expansion.
Fabhalta.campaign_posture: Multi-indication launch: sequence PNH -> IgAN -> C3G; disease-awareness + oral-convenience narrative; rare-disease HCP finding and patient identification.

evidence: Tafamidis franchise ~USD 6.3B worldwide in 2025 (+17%); still ~75% of ATTR-CM prescription volume.
Growth now driven by diagnosis expansion rather than uncontested share.
New competition entering: Attruby (acoramidis, ~$362M 2025, >25% NBRx share) and Amvuttra (vutrisiran, approved ATTR-CM Mar 2025).
key_catalysts: defense vs. acoramidis stabilizer and vutrisiran silencer
Vyndaqel.loe_horizon: Vyndamax composition patents contested; generics delayed via settlements (late-2020s)
Vyndaqel.whitespace: Still-large undiagnosed ATTR-CM pool; incumbency and experience as defense assets.
Vyndaqel.campaign_posture: Grow-the-diagnosis while defending share: disease-awareness/screening drives the category; incumbency, real-world experience and access as retention RTBs against new entrants.

evidence: Enfortumab vedotin + pembrolizumab established as 1L standard of care in locally-advanced/metastatic urothelial cancer (EV-302).
Displacing platinum chemotherapy in 1L la/mUC, a major share shift.
Astellas/Pfizer partnership; ADC + IO combination is category-defining.
Padcev.whitespace: Complete 1L conversion from chemo; move toward earlier/muscle-invasive disease.
Padcev.campaign_posture: Growth: entrench the EV+P 1L standard-of-care message; heavy AE-management enablement to sustain persistence; oncology + uro-onc activation.

evidence: RSV bivalent prefusion-F vaccine competing for share in older-adult (60+, 18+ at risk) and maternal segments.
Season-driven demand with ACIP recommendation dynamics shaping the addressable population.
Maternal immunization is a differentiated indication protecting infants.
main_competitors: no-vaccination / competing adult vaccines for share of visit
Abrysvo.whitespace: Maternal segment differentiation; expanding eligible-age recommendations.
Abrysvo.campaign_posture: Seasonal growth: time disease-awareness + co-administration messaging to the respiratory season; dual older-adult and maternal audiences; pharmacy + OB channels.

evidence: Full-year 2025 sales ~USD 4.12B (-6% YoY); multi-year decline expected to continue.
US patent-term extension to Mar 2027; key patents expire ~2027/2028; IRA price negotiation exposure.
First-in-class CDK4/6i now ceding share to abemaciclib and ribociclib (OS/adjuvant differentiation).
Ibrance.whitespace: Limited; adherent metastatic base and combination familiarity.
Ibrance.campaign_posture: LOE defense/harvest: protect adherent mBC base and prescriber habit, minimize new-patient spend against differentiated rivals, prepare for genericization.

evidence: Category-leading DOAC (with BMS) but managing IRA negotiated pricing (effective 2026) and approaching patent-cliff horizon.
Still growing in volume as category leader even as net pricing pressure builds.
Generic apixaban entry timing shaped by settlements/litigation.
Eliquis.whitespace: Sustain leadership and adherence in NVAF/VTE while managing net-price erosion.
Eliquis.campaign_posture: Mature-leader defense: adherence + safety leadership messaging, payer/access management under IRA, prepare LOE transition; disciplined spend.

evidence: Ritlecitinib (JAK3/TEC inhibitor) in early launch for severe alopecia areata (age 12+).
Differentiated by adolescent (12+) label in a category with few options.
Growing disease-awareness and treatment-seeking in AA.
Litfulo.whitespace: Adolescent segment ownership; large untreated AA population newly seeking therapy.
Litfulo.campaign_posture: Launch build: disease-state awareness + psychosocial burden narrative, adolescent-inclusive positioning, dermatology activation and patient-support enrollment.

evidence: Franchise anchor across myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera, acute and chronic GVHD; still growing modestly but LOE planning dominates strategy.
Minimum US/EU/JP exclusivity ~2028; multiple generic filers (Dr. Reddy's, Eugia, Apotex) queued.
Incyte's portfolio strategy centered on offsetting the Jakafi cliff.
Jakafi.whitespace: Retain treaters through LOE; GVHD and PV persistence; lifecycle formulations.
Jakafi.campaign_posture: Mature-defend with LOE runway: maximize adherent base and GVHD/PV franchises, support lifecycle formulations, disciplined pre-cliff investment.

evidence: Topical ruxolitinib cream growing in atopic dermatitis and nonsegmental vitiligo, including pediatric expansion.
Only topical JAK inhibitor; vitiligo is a differentiated, previously under-treated indication.
Repigmentation narrative drives durable, high-engagement treatment courses.
Opzelura.whitespace: Vitiligo is a largely untreated market Opzelura effectively created; AD topical switching.
Opzelura.campaign_posture: Growth: own the vitiligo repigmentation category, patient-activation for a visible/psychosocial condition, derm + patient DTC support; pediatric expansion.

evidence: Tafasitamab (anti-CD19) with full global rights consolidated by Incyte; expanding from R/R DLBCL into follicular lymphoma (inMIND).
inMIND FL expansion adds a new population to the DLBCL + lenalidomide base.
Positioned for community-deliverable regimens versus CAR-T/bispecific logistics.
Monjuvi.whitespace: FL expansion; community centers seeking non-CAR-T/bispecific options.
Monjuvi.campaign_posture: Growth: launch FL indication, emphasize community-deliverable outpatient regimen, differentiate on logistics vs. cell/bispecific therapies.

evidence: Axatilimab is the first anti-CSF-1R for chronic GVHD after failure of >=2 prior lines; early launch phase.
Novel mechanism (macrophage/fibrosis targeting) complementary to JAK/other cGVHD agents.
Adds a later-line option in a franchise Incyte already leads with ruxolitinib.
Niktimvo.whitespace: Later-line cGVHD with organ/fibrotic involvement; sequencing after JAK/ROCK2.
Niktimvo.campaign_posture: Specialist launch: transplant-center + GVHD-KOL focus, mechanism and sequencing education, narrow high-value audience with deep enablement.

evidence: Pemigatinib (FGFR inhibitor) is a niche precision-oncology asset with a steady, biomarker-capped population.
Cholangiocarcinoma (FGFR2 fusion) and myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms (FGFR1) define a small addressable pool.
Growth gated by biomarker testing rates rather than promotional reach.
Pemazyre.whitespace: Under-testing for FGFR alterations is the true ceiling; testing-advocacy is the growth lever.
Pemazyre.campaign_posture: Niche precision play: drive biomarker-testing advocacy (reflex FGFR testing), molecular-tumor-board engagement, efficient specialist targeting.
